messages.subject: covariances non-significant
parts:
My SEM output shows non-significant covariances between the exogenous variables and between one pair of indicators for which their errors are allowed to correlate. 
N=496; df=140; Likert-scales treat as continuous; est=MLR

What does it mean? Shall I just ignore it as long as model fit indices are fine?
The variances are all significant though.

Here the piece of code and the resulting covariances.
x1 and x2 - and - x3 and x4 are worded in a very similar way which is causing redundancy I guess. 

X=~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4
x1~~x2 
x3~~x4

D=~ d1 + d2 + d3
